summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the RDFLib SPARQL plugin. Changes: Update class added to rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py always returns an Update (empty-request path builds the prologue from q.prologue[0] and returns an empty algebra); evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added to processor.py and exported from sparql/__init__.py; new test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers the required behaviors. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests are unverified. Nothing committed. Open points: the empty-request path assumes q.prologue has one group; the initial-bindings test assumes an empty WHERE yields the initial bindings; test_dawg.py's debug-only pprintAlgebra call now receives an Update object.
